bundle.what: The gstack the gstack cheap-model run (gstack-cheap-model-2026-11) installs on Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks, where 50 of 60 task images have no git and the network install above cannot run: an offline bundle that gstack-bundle.sh builds once on the controller, which agents.py uploads into each task container before gstack's own ./setup runs there, as a user's install would. Used only by a delivery kwarg with install bundle (plan.ts gstack_delivery); the repo-task arms above keep the network install.
bundle.on: gstack's stable branch and its v1.104.0.0 tag (git ls-remote, 2026-11-26T19:45Z): the release a new install follows by default (docs/install.md, Team mode follows the stable channel)

bun.why: GSTACK_BUN_TESTED in bin/gstack-bun-version.sh at the commit: the supported minimum and the version setup tells a user to install (setup:330-336); the zip sha256 is gstack's own table's

content.rule: gstack-bundle.sh bundle-digest: sha256 over one line per file of the unpacked bundle (gstack/ and bun/), '<relative path>\0<file sha256>\n' ('<relative path>\0link:<target>\n' for a symlink), sorted by path, without the volatile paths below. vm-run.sh checks a shard's tarball against it once before any trial (<out>/gstack-bundle-check.json), and agents.py refuses a tarball whose sha256 is not that receipt's

volatile.why: git's stat cache: ctime, mtime, inode and device of every checked-out file
the checkout's reflog line holds the build time and the build machine's git identity
GitHub builds the shallow fetch's pack anew each time; the commit is checked from .git/HEAD and every checked-out file is in the digest
a build log with step timings and a staging directory name

bundle.start_hook: left at gstack's default, which is on for a new Hermes or OpenClaw registration at this version (lib/harness-start-hook.ts START_HOOK_DEFAULT); the trial checks that setup reports it active

build-check.hermes: gstack-build-check, listed as its own skill (registration mode all, lib/harness-register.ts:93)
build-check.openclaw: reached through the listed gstack router skill (registration mode hybrid lists gstack, review, qa, ship and plan-eng-review, lib/harness-register.ts:41-42 and :86)
